title: Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. stock rises Wednesday, outperforms market
summary: Shares of Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. (TMO) rose by 1.34% to $608.54 on Wednesday, outperforming the broader market. This increase snapped a four-day losing streak for the stock, as the S&P 500 Index and Dow Jones Industrial Average also saw gains.

title: Palo Alto Networks paid $500M for Thrive-backed Console, sources say
summary: Palo Alto Networks acquired Console, an AI-powered IT help desk automation startup, for $500 million in cash and stock. Console, founded in 2024, had raised $29 million and was valued at $157 million before the acquisition. This marks Palo Alto Networks' seventh acquisition in 2026, integrating Console's AI agent functionality into its Cortex platform to enhance autonomous security.

title: Microsoft Discloses Exact Azure Sales Figures For The First Time Following Longstanding Investor Demand
summary: Microsoft has announced it will begin providing specific quarterly revenue metrics for its Azure cloud platform, a move long awaited by investors. The company also revealed historical Azure sales, which reached $29.4 billion in the quarter ending June 2026 and over $100 billion for the most recent fiscal year. This increased transparency and a strategic reorganization of its core divisions reflect the growing impact of AI on Microsoft's business model.

title: Western Digital director Stephanie Streeter sells $2.5m in stock By Investing.com
summary: Stephanie A. Streeter, a director at Western Digital Corp. (NASDAQ:WDC), recently sold common stock valued at approximately $2.5 million. The sale involved 7,185 shares at prices between $447.06 and $455.0 per share, following a significant 450% return for the stock over the past year. Despite the sale, InvestingPro analysis indicates the stock remains undervalued, and Streeter retains substantial beneficial ownership.

title: Is Best Buy Co Inc (BBY) Overvalued After 3.1% Rally? GF Value Says Overvalued
summary: Best Buy Co Inc (BBY) shares recently rallied 3.1% to $82.63, but GuruFocus' GF Value™ indicates the stock is overvalued by 8.1% compared to its intrinsic value of $76.46. The company has an above-average GF Score™ of 75/100, reflecting strong financial strength and profitability but limited growth. Notably, insiders have sold $297.5 million worth of shares over the past year with no buying activity, suggesting a cautious approach for investors.

title: HPE stack serves Spurs stadium refit: VMware out, Juniper pending
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) has expanded its partnership with Tottenham Hotspur Football Club for a network refresh at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. The upgrade includes a shift away from VMware to HPE VM Essentials (VME), new HPE ProLiant Compute Gen12 servers for improved operations and reduced power consumption, and the early adoption of Wi-Fi 7 technology. The club also anticipates integrating Juniper Networks' Mist products in the future, further solidifying HPE's comprehensive IT infrastructure role.

title: T-Mobile Supports Indiana Communities Following Severe Weather and Prolonged Power Outages
summary: T-Mobile is providing support to Indiana communities affected by severe weather and prolonged power outages. The company is offering unlimited talk, text, and data to customers in impacted areas and has provided free Wi-Fi and device charging services in Northwest and east-central Indiana. T-Mobile also deployed portable generators and satellite backhaul solutions to maintain connectivity during recovery efforts.

title: KKR Agrees to Historic $250 Million Penalty for Alleged Violations of HSR Act
summary: KKR & Co., one of the world's largest private equity firms, has agreed to a historic $250 million penalty to settle allegations by the Department of Justice that it repeatedly violated the Hart-Scott-Rodino (HSR) Act. The DOJ's complaint accused KKR of submitting deficient HSR notification forms for 16 transactions and failing to notify federal antitrust enforcers of at least two reportable transactions. This settlement, along with a recent FTC settlement involving Edwards Lifesciences Corp. and Genesis MedTech Group Limited, underscores the government's continued focus on HSR compliance and the importance of robust compliance programs.

title: Jim Cramer Explains Why Heavily Shorted Moderna (MRNA) Has Room to Run
summary: Jim Cramer discussed Moderna (MRNA) on Mad Money, highlighting its potential for growth despite being heavily shorted. He pointed to Moderna's collaboration with Merck on a melanoma vaccine as a significant breakthrough, suggesting that skeptics who focused on the post-pandemic revenue decline might be missing the long-term value of its research investments. While acknowledging risks like cash burn and clinical execution, Cramer believes the company's oncology success could drive substantial upside as market sentiment shifts.

title: NetApp Earnings Beat Estimates. The Stock Is Falling Anyway.
summary: NetApp reported stronger-than-expected earnings and raised its fiscal year guidance. Despite the positive financial news, the data storage company's stock experienced a decline in after-hours trading.

title: AES Indiana customers' rake hike will face new scrutiny from state regulators
summary: The Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission has voted to rehear the case regarding a $71 million rate increase for AES Indiana customers, a decision that could delay or reverse parts of the hike. This reconsideration follows petitions from the state's utility watchdog and a consumer advocacy group, citing concerns over affordability, a proposed Google data center, and AES's pending acquisition by a BlackRock-led investor group. The decision highlights new scrutiny on utility operations and mergers, especially after recent commission turnovers and public denouncements from Gov. Mike Braun.

title: Insider Selling: Leidos (NYSE:LDOS) Director Sells 1,000 Shares
summary: Leidos director Gary Stephen May sold 1,000 shares of LDOS stock for $140.85 per share, totaling $140,850, reducing his ownership by 8.93%. Despite this insider selling, Leidos reported strong quarterly earnings and revenue, exceeding analyst expectations, and announced a new share buyback program and quarterly dividend. Analysts currently maintain a "Hold" rating for the stock with an average price target of $162.93.

title: L3Harris Technologies (LHX) On CEO Exit The Bull Case Still Points To Undervaluation
summary: L3Harris Technologies (LHX) is facing scrutiny after its CEO resigned, causing a recent dip in its share price. Despite this, the company is still considered undervalued by analysts, with a fair value estimate significantly above its current trading price due to anticipated growth in the U.S. defense budget and L3Harris's strong positioning in key defense areas. Investors are encouraged to review the company's prospects and risks to make informed decisions.

title: Oracle Sets the Date for its First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Earnings Announcement
summary: Oracle Corporation announced that its first-quarter fiscal year 2027 financial results will be released on Thursday, September 10, 2026, after the close of the market. The company will host a conference call and live webcast at 4:00 p.m. Central Time to discuss these results. The webcast will be accessible through Oracle's Investor Relations website.

title: Sempra declares quarterly dividend of $0.6575 per share By Investing.com
summary: Sempra announced that its board of directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.6575 per share on common stock. The dividend is scheduled to be paid on October 15, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 24, 2026. Sempra operates energy networks in California and Texas.

title: Amgen Stock Signals Its Confidence. The Market Agrees.
summary: Amgen's stock is climbing due to strong current performance, driven by six key growth products, and a recent revenue guidance increase for 2026. However, major investor interest and risk are tied to its late-stage pipeline, particularly the experimental obesity drug MariTide. The market is pricing in significant volatility, suggesting potential sharp swings around future catalysts.

title: Alexandria Real Estate Equities (NYSE:ARE) CAO Andres Gavinet Sells 10,000 Shares of Stock
summary: Alexandria Real Estate Equities' CAO Andres Gavinet sold 10,000 shares of the company's stock for $509,300, reducing his ownership by 8.89%. The company reported a quarterly revenue of $662.78 million and adjusted earnings of negative $0.43 per share, missing estimates, with revenue declining 13% year-over-year. Analysts currently have an average "Reduce" rating for ARE with a price target of $52.85, and the REIT declared a quarterly dividend of $0.72 per share.

title: ICF International (NASDAQ:ICFI) CEO Sells $565,248.00 in Stock
summary: ICF International CEO John Wasson sold 6,400 shares of company stock for $565,248, reducing his direct stake by over 50%. This transaction occurred under a pre-arranged trading plan, following a previous sale in July. The company recently reported better-than-expected EPS but slightly missed revenue forecasts, and has authorized a $100 million share repurchase program and declared a $0.14 quarterly dividend.

title: Insider Selling: Iron Mountain (NYSE:IRM) EVP Sells $693,600.00 in Stock
summary: Iron Mountain (NYSE: IRM) EVP Mark Kidd sold 6,000 shares of the company's stock for $693,600.00 on September 1st, reducing his ownership by 5.91%. This transaction occurred under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. Despite the insider selling, Iron Mountain recently reported strong quarterly revenues and adjusted earnings, exceeding analyst expectations, and declared a quarterly dividend.

title: Insider Selling: Synopsys (NASDAQ:SNPS) Insider Sells $11,044,000.00 in Stock
summary: Synopsys insider Geus Aart De sold 25,000 shares of the company's stock for $11.04 million on August 31st, reducing his direct ownership by 17.19%. This transaction, conducted under a Rule 10b5-1 plan, is part of a series of recent sales by De. Despite the insider selling, Synopsys recently exceeded quarterly earnings and revenue expectations, and analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for the stock.

title: Prologis Declares Quarterly Dividend
summary: Prologis, Inc. has announced that its Board of Directors declared a regular cash dividend for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. This includes a dividend of $1.07 per share for common stock and $1.0675 per share for the company's 8.54% Series Q Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock. Both dividends are payable on September 30, 2026, to stockholders of record as of September 16, 2026.

summary: Packaging Corporation of America (NYSE: PKG) has announced it will maintain its quarterly dividend at $1.50 per share. The dividend is payable on October 15 to shareholders of record as of September 15. This news was published on September 2, 2026, at 04:49 pm EDT.

summary: Stryker director Mary K. Brainerd increased her indirect holdings in the company by purchasing 131 shares across multiple transactions between June 2019 and November 2022, totaling $26,736. summary: Packaging Corporation of America (NYSE:PKG) has declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.50 per share on its common stock. summary: Packaging Corporation of America (NYSE:PKG) has declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.50 per share on its common stock. title: NetApp Earnings Beat Estimates. The Stock is Falling Anyway.
summary: NetApp (NTAP) reported stronger-than-expected earnings and raised its fiscal year guidance. Despite the positive financial results, the company's stock experienced a decline in after-hours trading. The article suggests that issues related to cash and inventory drags might be contributing to the slump in shares.

title: Broadcom Beats Q3 Estimates as AI Revenue Jumps 221%, Shares Slide on Soft Guidance
summary: Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) reported strong Q3 fiscal 2026 results, surpassing revenue and earnings estimates, driven by a 221% year-over-year increase in AI semiconductor revenue. Despite the strong performance, the company's shares slid in after-hours trading due to soft guidance for the fourth quarter. Broadcom expects continued momentum in AI revenue, forecasting a 236% year-over-year increase in Q4.

title: RTX Corp. stock underperforms Wednesday when compared to competitors
summary: RTX Corp. (RTX) shares fell by 2.13% to $200.78 on Wednesday, marking its fourth consecutive day of losses. This underperformance occurred despite a positive trading session for the broader market, with the S&P 500 Index rising 0.46% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average gaining 0.56%.

title: Goldman Sachs Discloses 2.93% Stake in QIAGEN via Shares and Derivatives
summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. has reported a 2.93% aggregate stake in QIAGEN (QGEN) through a combination of shares, derivatives, warrants, and convertible bonds, as revealed in an AFM filing. This disclosure indicates Goldman Sachs' indirect real and potential interests, highlighting a notable but non-controlling financial involvement in the company. QIAGEN, a Netherlands-based life sciences company, specializes in sample and assay technologies.

title: Goldman Sachs Discloses 3.15% Stake in Qiagen via AFM Filing
summary: Goldman Sachs has disclosed a combined real and potential interest of 3.15% in Qiagen's share capital and voting rights, according to a notification from the Dutch regulator AFM. This stake is held through various instruments and entities, including ordinary shares, swaps, options, warrants, and convertible bonds. The disclosure highlights Goldman Sachs as a significant institutional investor in Qiagen, a Netherlands-based life sciences company.

title: Elliott has built stake in Deutsche Telekom, opposes T-Mobile merger, Bloomberg News reports
summary: Activist investor Elliott Investment Management has reportedly built a significant stake in Deutsche Telekom and is advocating against a potential merger with T-Mobile US. Elliott is urging the German telecom company to explore other avenues for increasing shareholder value, such as larger share buybacks. Deutsche Telekom holds a nearly 54% stake in its American arm, T-Mobile.

title: Costco reports August sales of $23.7 billion, up 9.9%
summary: Costco Wholesale Corporation reported strong sales figures for August, the fourth quarter, and the full fiscal year ended August 30, 2026. Net sales for August increased by 9.9% to $23.70 billion, while fourth-quarter net sales grew by 11.3% to $93.9 billion. The full fiscal year saw net sales reach $297.3 billion, marking a 10.2% increase from the previous year.

title: THE HERSHEY COMPANY NAMES DAVE HULAYS CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER
summary: The Hershey Company has announced the appointment of Dave Hulays as its new Chief Financial Officer. This announcement was made on September 2, 2026.

title: HPE follows in Dell’s footsteps as it rides the AI server boom to a big earnings beat
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) reported strong July-quarter earnings, exceeding revenue and earnings per share expectations. The company attributes this success to increased demand for its AI server and networking portfolio, focusing on enterprise and sovereign customers. This performance mirrors Dell's recent surge, driven by the booming AI server market.

title: After 59 Years, Southwest Airlines Is Opening Its First Airport Lounges. Access Comes With 1 Big Catch
summary: Southwest Airlines is set to launch its first airport lounge network in late 2027, nearly six decades after its founding. This move is part of a 30-year partnership with Chase, aiming to offer premium travel perks. Access to these new lounges will exclusively be available through a new, premium Southwest Rapid Rewards® Credit Card issued by Chase, which will also launch in 2027.

title: Quanta Services declares $0.11 quarterly dividend
summary: Quanta Services Inc. (NYSE:PWR) has announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.11 per share. The dividend will be payable on October 9, 2026, to stockholders of record as of October 1, 2026, representing an annualized rate of $0.44 per share. Quanta Services specializes in providing infrastructure solutions across various industries in North America and other international markets.

title: Boeing paid $3.1 million fine to FAA over widespread safety violations
summary: Boeing has paid a $3.1 million fine to the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) for various safety violations, including issues connected to the 2024 Alaska Airlines MAX 9 mid-air emergency. The FAA had also previously fined Boeing for interfering with safety officials' independence and presenting unairworthy aircraft for approval. Despite the fine, some critics, like Senator Richard Blumenthal, view it as insufficient to deter dangerous behavior.

title: Aflac Incorporated to Present at the 2026 KBW Insurance Conference
summary: Aflac Incorporated announced that Senior Executive Vice President and CFO Max K. Brodén will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 KBW Insurance Conference on September 10, 2026, at 9:50 a.m. ET. The presentation will be webcast live, and a replay will be available afterward. The company, a Fortune 500 entity, provides supplemental health insurance in the U.S. and cancer/medical insurance in Japan.

title: American Tower to Present at Upcoming September Conferences
summary: American Tower Corporation (NYSE: AMT) announced its scheduled presentations at two upcoming investor conferences in September 2026. The company will present at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference and Citi's Global TMT Conference. Live webcasts and replays of these presentations will be available on American Tower's investor relations website.

title: Elliott has built stake in Deutsche Telekom, opposes T-Mobile merger, Bloomberg News reports
summary: Elliott Investment Management has reportedly acquired a significant stake in Deutsche Telekom and is advocating against a potential merger with T-Mobile US. The activist investor suggests Deutsche Telekom should instead explore other avenues for shareholder value, such as increased share buybacks. This comes after previous reports indicated Deutsche Telekom was considering such a merger, which T-Mobile's US executives reportedly no longer support.

title: BillionToOne to Participate in the Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference
summary: BillionToOne, Inc. (NASDAQ: BLLN) announced its management will participate in the Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference. The company's management will hold a fireside chat on Wednesday, September 9, 2026, from 2:15 pm to 2:50 pm Eastern Time, with a webcast available on their investor relations website. BillionToOne is a molecular diagnostics company focused on creating accessible and accurate genetic tests using its proprietary single-molecule next-generation sequencing (smNGS) platform.

title: (HPE) Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company Expects Q4 Revenue Range $13.9B - $14.8B
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) announced its Q4 revenue is expected to be between $13.9 billion and $14.8 billion. This news follows a report that HPE's fiscal Q3 non-GAAP earnings and revenue rose, and the company also expects fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS to be in the range of $3.75-$3.85. The company's stock symbol is HPE.

title: Halozyme Therapeutics stock hits all-time high at 109.69 USD
summary: Halozyme Therapeutics Inc. (HALO) stock reached an all-time high of $109.69, marking a 46.06% increase over the past year and a 60% gain year-to-date. The company's robust performance is supported by strong financials, including 41% revenue growth in the last twelve months and a "GREAT" Financial Health Score from InvestingPro. Recent Q2 2026 results surpassed Wall Street expectations, with non-GAAP earnings of $2.28 per share and $481 million in revenue, leading to raised full-year guidance and positive analyst ratings.

title: Oracle Sets the Date for its First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Earnings Announcement
summary: Oracle Corporation announced that its first-quarter fiscal year 2027 financial results will be released on Thursday, September 10, 2026, after the market closes. The company will host a conference call and live webcast at 4:00 p.m. Central Time to discuss these results, which will be accessible via the Oracle Investor Relations website.

title: Six Degrees Intelligence Brings China Market Insights to S&P Capital IQ Pro
summary: Six Degrees Intelligence, a leading qualitative research platform in China, has announced a content collaboration with S&P Global Market Intelligence to make its research available via Capital IQ Pro. This partnership will provide global financial professionals with high-quality insights on China's industries, technologies, and green energy transition. The collaboration highlights growing international interest in China and Six Degrees' commitment to connecting global experts with Chinese enterprises and providing Chinese expert access globally through a rigorous compliance process.

title: Deere, CNH stocks surge after Evercore ISI upgrade
summary: Deere & Company and CNH Industrial NV shares rose significantly after Evercore ISI upgraded both agricultural equipment manufacturers to Outperform. Analyst David Raso cited factors such as an aged U.S. high horsepower agricultural fleet, reduced channel inventory, and improving precision agriculture technology for the upgrades, raising price targets for both companies. The firm projects strong earnings per share for Deere and CNH by 2027 and 2028, driven by expected replacement demand and a recovery in the agricultural equipment sector.

title: UnitedHealth Group (NYSE:UNH) Expands Behavioral Coaching Access
summary: UnitedHealth Group (NYSE:UNH) has expanded access to child and family behavioral coaching to approximately thirteen million commercial members. This initiative is part of a broader effort by the company to streamline administrative processes, including removing prior authorization requirements for many services and implementing a national gold card arrangement for clinicians who follow evidence-based guidelines. These changes aim to improve member and clinician interactions while addressing the growing demand for behavioral health services in the U.S.

title: ISRG Stock: The Best House On The Block Costs The Most
summary: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) is the leading company in robotic-assisted surgery, but despite its operational excellence and strong revenue growth, its stock has underperformed, trailing the S&P 500 significantly. The company commands the highest valuation among its peers due to strong demand for its da Vinci 5 system and international expansion, but faces challenges with moderating U.S. market growth. Investors are watching closely to see if Intuitive Surgical can meet its guided procedure growth range to validate its premium valuation.

title: First American Title President Sally French Tyler Named a HousingWire Vanguard Award Winner for the Second Time
summary: Sally French Tyler, President of First American Title Insurance Company, has been honored with HousingWire's 2026 Vanguard Award for the second time, recognizing her exceptional leadership, business acumen, and commitment to innovation and empowering women. Tyler led First American Title to strong financial performance, with significant revenue increases in 2025 and 2026, and also launched a consumer-protection innovation and co-founded the company's Women in Leadership initiative. She will be retiring at the end of the year, leaving behind a legacy of growth and people-focused leadership.

title: HIMS & HERS HEALTH, INC. (HIMS) INVESTOR ALERT Investors
summary: Bernstein Liebhard LLP has announced a securities class action lawsuit against Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (HIMS) on behalf of investors who purchased securities between August 4, 2025, and July 29, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that the company made false and misleading statements about its business operations, growth prospects, and financial stability, leading to significant losses for investors. Shareholders with large losses are encouraged to contact Bernstein Liebhard LLP to discuss their rights and potentially serve as lead plaintiff.
